svg.title: Tech stack: bill of materials
svg.desc: Exploded isometric assembly of seven stacked plates (languages, backend, frontend, AI, data, devops, cloud) held by two tie rods (testing and observability), with a bill of materials table. Primary items: Python, C#/.NET, JavaScript, FastAPI, Flask, .NET Web API, React, Angular, AWS, PyTest. LANGUAGES: Python, C# / .NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, Swift, Java, Bash, SQL. BACKEND: FastAPI, Flask / Flask-RESTX, .NET Web API / Core, Node / Express, Django. FRONTEND: React, Angular / AngularJS, Vue, Redux, SwiftUI. AI: Claude Code + MCP + Copilot, local RAG: LangChain, Ollama, ChromaDB, Tesseract OCR. DATA: MS SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redshift, DynamoDB, Tableau, pandas / NumPy. DEVOPS: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins. CLOUD: AWS, Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, EventBridge, S3, Glue / Spark, EKS / ECS, Azure, Heroku. TESTING: PyTest, Playwright BDD, Vitest / RTL, XCTest, TDD. OBSERVABILITY: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, CloudWatch, Azure App Insights.
svg.text: Exploded assembly, items keyed to the table. Testing and observability are the tie rods that fasten every layer.
= primary material, ranked by evidence across roles and repos
